name: writing
description: Publication-prep tools for academic and public-facing writing. Four skills: style (17 canonical English-prose rules, 19 page-cap additions, 2 audit-time rules), preflight (deterministic pre-submission checks on a LaTeX tree), plot (18 matplotlib chart templates) and concept (3 schematic templates), the two figure skills sharing one design system under figures/: Google palette, venue-matched fonts, one header format, and the eleven-rule DOCTRINE.md. The integrity-forensics suite is the separate anti-autoresearch plugin.
